info.name: SpaceCMU API (Organized)
info.description:
Complete collection for testing all SpaceCMU Backend endpoints on Port 3001, organized with nested folders.

## WebSocket Events (Socket.io)

### Client → Server Events:

**user:online**
- Payload: `userId: string`
- Description: User connects and announces they are online

**message:send**
- Payload: `{ senderId: string, receiverId: string, content: string, messageId: string, createdAt: string }`
- Description: Send a real-time message to another user

**typing:start**
- Payload: `{ userId: string, otherUserId: string }`
- Description: User starts typing in a conversation

**typing:stop**
- Payload: `{ userId: string, otherUserId: string }`
- Description: User stops typing in a conversation

**message:read**
- Payload: `{ messageId: string, userId: string }`
- Description: Mark a message as read

### Server → Client Events:

**user:status**
- Payload: `{ userId: string, status: 'online' | 'offline' }`
- Description: Broadcast when a user goes online or offline

**message:receive**
- Payload: `{ id: string, senderId: string, receiverId: string, content: string, isRead: boolean, createdAt: string }`
- Description: Receive a new message in real-time

**message:sent**
- Payload: `{ messageId: string, success: boolean }`
- Description: Confirmation that message was sent successfully

**typing:status**
- Payload: `{ userId: string, isTyping: boolean }`
- Description: Receive typing status from another user

**message:read:update**
- Payload: `{ messageId: string, readBy: string }`
- Description: Notification that a message was read

item.name: Get User By ID (Enhanced with Friendship Status)

header.description: Optional. If provided, response includes friendship status.

request.description:
Get user profile by ID. When authenticated and viewing another user's profile, returns additional friendship information:

**Response Fields (when authenticated):**
- `friendshipStatus`: "none" | "pending" | "accepted" | "blocked"
- `isPendingFrom`: "me" | "them" | null (who sent the pending request)
- `mutualFriendsCount`: number (count of mutual friends if status is "accepted")

**Use Cases:**
- `friendshipStatus: "none"` → Show "Add Friend" button
- `friendshipStatus: "pending"` + `isPendingFrom: "me"` → Show "Request Sent"
- `friendshipStatus: "pending"` + `isPendingFrom: "them"` → Show "Accept/Reject" buttons
- `friendshipStatus: "accepted"` → Show "Friends" + mutual friends count

**Note:** Friendship fields are NOT included when:
- Not authenticated
- Viewing own profile

Search for users by firstName, lastName, username, studentId, or full name.

**Search Criteria:**
- **First Name**: `query=somchai`
- **Last Name**: `query=CMU`
- **Full Name**: `query=somchai cmu`
- **Username**: `query=somchai_cmu` or `query=@somchai_cmu`
- **Student ID**: `query=650612102`

**Features:**
- Case-insensitive search
- Partial matching (contains)
- Excludes current user from results
- Maximum 20 results

**Response Format:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "user-uuid",
    "firstName": "Somchai",
    "lastName": "CMU",
    "username": "somchai_cmu",
    "studentId": "650610000",
    "avatarUrl": "/uploads/avatar.jpg",
    "bio": "Engineering student",
    "faculty": "Engineering",
    "major": "Computer Engineering",
    "year": 3,
    "friendsCount": 42
  }
]
```

**Note:** @ prefix is automatically removed from username searches

formdata.value: Check out these photos and videos!

request.description:
Create a post with multiple images and/or videos. Supports up to 20 files per post. Each file can be up to 50MB. Supported formats: jpeg, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp4, mov, avi, mkv.

**Optional Event Fields:**
You can create an event post by adding these optional fields:
- `eventTitle` (string) - Event name
- `eventDescription` (string) - Event details
- `eventStartTime` (string) - ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-20T14:00:00Z')
- `eventEndTime` (string) - ISO 8601 format (optional)
- `eventType` (string) - 'event', 'class', 'activity', 'appointment' (default: 'event')

**Example Event Post:**
```
content: 'Join our React Workshop!'
category: 'Events'
eventTitle: 'React Workshop for Beginners'
eventDescription: 'Learn React fundamentals'
eventStartTime: '2026-02-20T14:00:00Z'
eventEndTime: '2026-02-20T17:00:00Z'
eventType: 'class'
```

Users can then accept the event using `POST /api/posts/:postId/accept-event` to add it to their calendar.

query.description: Optional. Values: Global (default, all except Friends), Friends (friends' posts only), Announcements, Events, Questions, Marketplaces, Shops

request.description:
Get posts by category.

**Categories:**
- **Global** (default): All posts except Friends category
- **Friends**: Only posts from friends (requires authentication)
- **Announcements**: Only Announcements posts
- **Events**: Only Events posts
- **Questions**: Only Questions posts  
- **Marketplaces**: Only Marketplaces posts
- **Shops**: Only Shops posts

**Response includes:**
- Post data with media array
- Author info: firstName, lastName, displayName, avatarUrl

variable.description: UUID of the post to delete

request.description:
Delete a post (only the post owner can delete).

**Authorization:**
- User must be authenticated
- User must be the owner of the post

**Cascade Delete:**
When a post is deleted, the following related data is automatically deleted:
- All media files in `post_media` table
- All comments on the post
- All likes on the post
- All saved references to the post
- All reposts of the post

**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Post deleted successfully"
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- 401: Not authenticated
- 403: Forbidden (not the post owner)
- 404: Post not found

Get all posts that the current user has liked.

**Response includes:**
- Post details with author info
- `likedAt`: Timestamp when user liked the post
- Sorted by most recently liked

**Use case:** Display user's liked posts history in their profile

variable.description: User ID to fetch posts from

request.description:
Get all posts created by a specific user. Used for viewing user profiles.

**Response includes:**
- Post details (id, content, category, likeCount, commentCount, repostCount)
- Author info (firstName, lastName, avatarUrl)
- Media array (sorted by order)
- Sorted by most recent first

**Use case:** Display posts on user profile pages

Send a message to the seller with product information.

**Request Body:**
- `itemId` (required): UUID of the market item
- `buyerId` (required): UUID of the buyer (current user)
- `customMessage` (optional): Custom message to prepend before product info

**Auto-generated Message Format:**
If customMessage is provided:
```
{customMessage}

---
สินค้าที่สนใจ: {title}
ราคา: ฿{price}
รายละเอียด: {description}
```

If no customMessage:
```
สวัสดีครับ/ค่ะ สนใจสินค้าของคุณ

สินค้า: {title}
ราคา: ฿{price}
รายละเอียด: {description}

สามารถติดต่อได้ไหมครับ/ค่ะ
```

**Response Example (201):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Message sent to seller successfully",
  "data": {
    "messageId": "msg-uuid",
    "sellerId": "seller-uuid",
    "sellerName": "John Doe",
    "itemTitle": "Calculator",
    "sentMessage": {
      "id": "msg-uuid",
      "senderId": "buyer-uuid",
      "receiverId": "seller-uuid",
      "content": "...",
      "isRead": false,
      "createdAt": "2026-01-11T..."
    }
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- 400: Missing required fields or trying to contact yourself
- 404: Market item not found
- 500: Server error

Get top 3 most recently active friends with their last active status, sorted by most recently active.

**Returns:** Maximum 3 friends

**Response Format:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "...",
    "firstName": "People",
    "lastName": "1",
    "avatarUrl": "...",
    "lastActiveAt": "2026-01-12T14:25:00.000Z",
    "activityStatus": "Active now",
    "minutesAgo": 0,
    "isOnline": true
  },
  {
    "activityStatus": "Active 2m ago",
    "minutesAgo": 2,
    "isOnline": false
  },
  {
    "activityStatus": "Active 5m ago",
    "minutesAgo": 5,
    "isOnline": false
  }
]
```

**Activity Status:**
- "Active now" (< 1 min)
- "Active Xm ago" (< 60 min)
- "Active Xh ago" (< 24 hours)
- "Active Xd ago" (>= 24 hours)
- "Offline" (never active)

**isOnline:** true if active within 5 minutes

**Update Behavior:**
- Updates on page refresh
- Updates when navigating back to page
- NOT real-time (no WebSocket)

item.name: Get Friend Suggestions (People You May Know)

request.description:
Get personalized friend suggestions using intelligent matching algorithms.

**Two Strategies:**

1. **No Friends Yet** - Suggests users with nearby student IDs
   - 5 users before your student ID
   - 5 users after your student ID
   - Total: up to 10 suggestions

2. **Has Friends** - Suggests friends of friends
   - Random 10 from your friends' friends
   - Sorted by mutual friends count
   - Excludes existing friends and self

**Caching:**
- Results cached for 5 minutes
- Reduces database load
- Faster response times

**Response Format:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "user-uuid",
    "firstName": "People",
    "lastName": "5",
    "username": "people5",
    "studentId": "650612097",
    "avatarUrl": "/avatar.jpg",
    "bio": "Design is my passion",
    "faculty": "Engineering",
    "major": "Computer Engineering",
    "year": 3,
    "friendsCount": 42,
    "mutualFriendsCount": 5,
    "suggestionReason": "nearby_student_id"
  },
  {
    "mutualFriendsCount": 3,
    "suggestionReason": "friend_of_friend"
  }
]
```

**Suggestion Reasons:**
- `nearby_student_id` - User has similar student ID
- `friend_of_friend` - User is friend of your friend

**Features:**
- Smart matching based on user state
- Mutual friends count for social proof
- Cached for performance
- Maximum 10 suggestions

request.description: Get all calendar events for the current user. Uses session activeUserId automatically.
Update event status. Status values: 'pending', 'completed', 'cancelled'. Use 'completed' for Success button.
Delete a calendar event. Only the event owner can delete their events.

Toggle event status between completed (success) and cancelled (unsuccess).

**Toggle Logic:**
- `completed` → `cancelled`
- `cancelled` → `completed`
- `pending` → `completed` (first toggle)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Event marked as completed",
  "event": {
    "id": "event-uuid",
    "userId": "user-uuid",
    "title": "Event Title",
    "status": "completed",
    "startTime": "2026-02-20T14:00:00.000Z",
    "endTime": "2026-02-20T17:00:00.000Z",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-12T13:36:31.414Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-02-12T06:52:52.764Z"
  }
}
```

Accept an event from a post and add it to your calendar. The post must have event data attached.

**Features:**
- Adds event to user's calendar
- Prevents duplicate acceptance
- Returns existing event if already accepted

**Response (Success):**
```json
{
  "message": "Event accepted successfully",
  "event": {
    "id": "calendar-event-uuid",
    "userId": "user-uuid",
    "title": "React Workshop for Beginners",
    "description": "Workshop description",
    "startTime": "2026-02-20T14:00:00.000Z",
    "endTime": "2026-02-20T17:00:00.000Z",
    "type": "class",
    "status": "pending",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-12T13:36:31.414Z"
  }
}
```

**Response (Already Accepted):**
```json
{
  "message": "Event already accepted",
  "event": { /* existing event */ }
}
```

item.name: Chat Rooms
item.description: Manage chat rooms for both 1-on-1 and group conversations

request.description:
Create a 1-on-1 chat room with another user. If room already exists, returns existing room.

**Request Body:**
- `otherUserId` (required): UUID of the other user

**Response Example:**
```json
{
  "message": "Direct room created successfully",
  "room": {
    "id": "room-uuid",
    "isGroup": false,
    "createdBy": "your-user-id",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-04T10:00:00Z"
  },
  "isNew": true
}
```

Create a group chat room.

**Request Body:**
- `name` (required): Group name
- `memberIds` (required): Array of user UUIDs to add
- `avatarUrl` (optional): Group avatar URL

**Response Example:**
```json
{
  "message": "Group room created successfully",
  "room": {
    "id": "room-uuid",
    "name": "Study Group",
    "avatarUrl": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
    "isGroup": true,
    "createdBy": "your-user-id",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-04T10:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

Get all chat rooms the user is a member of.

**Response:** Array of rooms with:
- Room details
- Member list
- Last message
- Unread count
- For 1-on-1: displays other user's name/avatar
Get details of a specific room including all members.
Update room name and/or avatar. **Admin only** for group chats.

item.name: Room Messages
item.description: Send and manage messages within chat rooms

request.description:
Send a message to a chat room.

**Request Body:**
- `roomId` (required): Room UUID
- `content` (required): Message content

**Backward Compatible:** Also accepts `receiverId` instead of `roomId` for legacy support.
Get messages in a room with pagination. Returns newest first.
Mark all messages in a room as read. Updates `lastReadAt` timestamp.
Soft delete a message. Only the sender can delete their messages.
Search messages across user's rooms. Can filter by specific room.
Add a member to a group room. **Admin only**. Cannot add to 1-on-1 rooms.
Remove a member from a group room. **Admin only**. Cannot remove yourself (use Leave Room instead).
Leave a chat room. Room is auto-deleted if it becomes empty.
